entry.title: Plasma-to-blanket source coupling
entry.summary: Four recorded runs use candidate-linked position/direction banks. The front-header local yield penalty persists; source geometry and reactor return-flux uncertainty remain.

entry.title: Recorded trajectories and 3D heating
entry.summary: Source-direction stress tests and actual OpenMC trajectories/voxel scores were linked to the Unreal and browser 3D lab. No fabricated coolant velocity or temperature field.

entry.title: Header placement enters neutron transport
entry.summary: Equal-inventory local cells were compared using six runs. The front layout was not accepted solely on its hydraulic result.

entry.title: Evidence reader and confinement accounting
entry.summary: Full cleared reports and superseded findings became searchable. Known accounting conventions were applied without claiming new fusion physics.

entry.title: Full-system numerical reference
entry.summary: The lifetime-constrained systems model converged with positive conditional modeled net electricity. It is not a qualified 30-year magnet or measured power plant.
